solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Uncertain Tories rule haphazardly

indicators.note: done haphazardly, without order, so these two words have their letters jumbled

explanation.surface: The Conservatives govern in a random, dithering way.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone irresolute cannot make up their mind, so is unsure or wavering.

clue.text: Burning problem husband ignored

indicators.note: ignored means left out, so one letter is dropped from the synonym

parts.note: a hitch is a snag or problem

explanation.surface: A pressing difficulty that the man of the house chose to overlook.
explanation.definitionFit: A burning sensation on the skin is an irritation of the kind one wants to scratch, a noun sense of burning.

clue.text: Career's close to launching having been on the blower

parts.note: to career is to rush along, to run; the 's is just the possessive

indicators.note: the close of a word is its final letter, here of launching

explanation.surface: A career that reached its launch after a lot of phone calls.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Blower' is British slang for the telephone; 'rung' is the past participle of ring, to phone.
explanation.definitionFit: Having phoned someone is having rung them, the past participle of ring in its telephone sense.

clue.text: Creep, cold one hurting Indian performer?

parts.note: to snake is to creep or slither along
C is the abbreviation for cold, as on taps
one who hurts or harms is a harmer

explanation.surface: A sneaky, chilly person causing pain to a stage entertainer from India.
explanation.definitionFit: The classic street entertainer of India plays a pipe to make a cobra rise from a basket.

clue.text: Free toilets ending in theatre

parts.note: loo is British slang for a toilet, so toilets are loos

indicators.note: the ending in the word theatre is its last letter

explanation.surface: Theatre loos are open to all at no charge.
explanation.definitionFit: To set something free is to let it loose; both mean unrestrained or unconfined.

clue.text: Performer can depart happy

indicators.note: happy here in the loose sense of carefree and tumbling, signalling the letters rearrange

explanation.surface: An entertainer is free to leave and pleased to do so.
explanation.definitionFit: A dancer who taps out rhythms with metal-plated shoes is a stage performer.

clue.text: A couple mean to entertain one

indicators.note: to entertain a guest is to hold them within, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: par is the average or mean level
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Two people who are stingy about having a guest round.
explanation.definitionFit: Two things together form a pair, just as two people make a couple.

clue.text: Our van (a ute) reshaped a design movement

indicators.note: reshaped means given a new form, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A van and a utility truck remodelled in a decorative style.
explanation.walkthrough: A ute is an Australian name for a pick-up truck.
explanation.definitionFit: Art Nouveau is the flowing decorative style of art and design of around 1900.

clue.text: True Berber cultivated a plant

indicators.note: cultivated suggests ground worked over, so the letters are turned into a new order

explanation.surface: A genuine North African farmer grew some crop.
explanation.walkthrough: Berbers are the indigenous people of North Africa.
explanation.definitionFit: The rubber tree is a tropical plant whose sap yields latex.

clue.text: Incline towards a glass for fruit

parts.note: to cant is to tilt or lean towards one side
a loupe is a jeweller's magnifying glass

explanation.surface: Lean towards a drinking glass to get some fruit.
explanation.definitionFit: A cantaloupe is a type of melon with orange flesh, so a fruit.

clue.text: Crazy about this attack

indicators.note: about here means turned round, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: bats is slang for crazy

explanation.surface: Someone is mad about this assault.
explanation.definitionFit: A stab is a thrust with a knife, a kind of attack.

clue.text: Really, really big on eating great food, no good

indicators.note: no here says the following letter is absent from the longer word

parts.note: gastronomical relates to fine eating, the enjoyment of great food

explanation.surface: Someone keen on eating fine food that turns out to be bad.
explanation.definitionFit: Astronomical figures are enormous, as vast as distances in space.

clue.text: Officers rushed into village shop

parts.note: generals are senior army officers
tore means rushed or raced

explanation.surface: Army chiefs hurried into the local store.
explanation.definitionFit: A general store is a small rural shop selling a wide range of goods.

clue.text: Frown almost came so easily with a problem

indicators.note: easily suggests loosely or freely, so the letters are rearranged
almost means nearly all, so the last letter of came is dropped

explanation.surface: A scowl came so readily when there was trouble.
explanation.walkthrough: 'almost' trims 'came' to CAM; FROWN, CAM and SO are then mixed together by 'easily'.
explanation.definitionFit: Opening a can of worms means creating a complicated problem.

clue.text: Twerp! I am one behind schedule for pick up

parts.note: an ass is a fool or twerp
I am contracts to I'm
I is the Roman numeral for one
late means behind schedule

explanation.surface: An insult from someone who is running late for a collection.
explanation.definitionFit: To pick up knowledge is to absorb or take it in, the sense of assimilate.

clue.text: I teach set differently about the appreciation of beauty

indicators.note: differently means arranged another way, so the letters are reordered

explanation.surface: A teacher setting a course on what makes things beautiful.
explanation.definitionFit: An aesthetic is a set of principles concerning beauty and taste.

clue.text: Change the reason I'm stuck on platform? I must leave

indicators.note: must leave means the named letter is taken out

parts.words: the reason I'm stuck on platform
parts.note: a waiting commuter's excuse: the train's late
I is taken as written

explanation.surface: A frustrated commuter stranded at the station wants to go.
explanation.definitionFit: To translate text is to change it into another language.

clue.text: Arrest ex-doughboy on Rhode Island

indicators.note: on means placed after, in an across answer

parts.note: a doughboy was an American infantryman, so an ex-doughboy is a veteran, a vet

explanation.surface: Detaining a former US soldier in a New England state.
explanation.definitionFit: To arrest attention is to rivet it, holding it fixed.

clue.text: Basketmaker is more comfortable with head covered

indicators.note: with its head covered, the first letter is hidden from view and so lost

parts.note: cosier means snugger, more comfortable

explanation.surface: A craftsperson weaving baskets is snugger in a hat.
explanation.definitionFit: Osier is a willow whose pliant twigs are used to weave baskets.

clue.text: Gasp! Cut drying clutch and engine part

indicators.note: cut means shortened, so the final letter is lopped off

parts.note: airing laundry is drying it
to clutch is to grasp or take

explanation.surface: A startled breath while grabbing the laundry and a car component.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Gasp!' is a further hint at the whole answer, a sudden intake of air.
explanation.definitionFit: An air intake is the opening through which an engine draws in air.

clue.text: Author's caught by inclination, ergo no clue for this!

parts.note: a writer is an author
C is the cricket abbreviation for caught
a ramp is a slope or incline

explanation.surface: A setter confesses to being stuck with no clue to write.
explanation.definitionFit: Writer's block, or a seized hand, leaves one unable to produce a word, hence no clue.

clue.text: Docile rector holds back an item of historic interest

indicators.note: back means the run is read in reverse
the phrase holds a run of letters within it

explanation.surface: A meek clergyman keeps hold of an antique.
explanation.definitionFit: A relic is an object surviving from the past, of historic interest.

clue.text: Joke about closing piece

parts.note: cod is a hoax or joke
A is the abbreviation for about, as in dates

explanation.surface: A jest concerning the final number.
explanation.definitionFit: A coda is the concluding passage of a musical work.

clue.text: Loafer, say, is indoors but not beginnng to move

parts.note: is contracts to 's

indicators.note: but not means the named letter is excluded

parts.note: at home means indoors

indicators.note: the beginning of a word is its first letter, here of move (the clue misspells beginning)

explanation.surface: An idle person stays inside and doesn't start to stir.
explanation.definitionFit: A loafer is one example of a slip-on shoe, hence 'say'.

clue.text: Speak about flier

parts.note: re means about or concerning
an ad is an advertisement, such as a flier

explanation.surface: Talk about a pamphlet.
explanation.definitionFit: To read a passage aloud is to speak it.

clue.text: Suggest a great deal in church linen

parts.note: to table a motion is to put forward or suggest it

indicators.note: in means one piece sits inside the other

parts.note: a lot means a great deal

explanation.surface: Proposing a large amount of church linen.
explanation.definitionFit: Table linen includes the cloth spread over a dining table.

clue.text: In which lawnmower is kept in Slough

definitions.meaning: a garden outbuilding where tools and mowers are stored
to slough off skin is to cast it off

explanation.walkthrough: Slough looks like the English town, but it is the verb to cast off skin.
explanation.definitionFit: A garden hut stores the mower; a snake casting its skin is doing the same as sloughing.

clue.text: Writers collected in these surprisingly nice places

indicators.note: surprisingly suggests something unexpected, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Authors gather in these unexpectedly pleasant spots.
explanation.definitionFit: Pens and pencils, writing implements, are kept together in this small container.
